name: 045.1 — a free entity holds its durable place
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 045.1: what a hafen.vr() entity standing at a POINT keeps is the durable anchor — the server's grid id plus the offset in it — while its session coordinate is derived from it; a place with no durable form is refused at :add and at :position(p), naming why.
